description: Potentiel des STEP is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AtmoSud. Potentiel des stations d'épuration (Nm3/h). Détails des noms des champs raccourcis: cosdr=codesandre, meth=methanisation, prmwhan=prodmwhan, prponm3=prodpotentiellenm3ch4tmvs, prtotkg=prodtotkgms, prtotnm3=prodtotnm3ch4, prtotnm3h=prodtotnm3ch4h. Coverage: AtmoSud. The publisher named on the listing is AtmoSud. Its keywords include inspire, ogc-wfs-2-0-0-http-get-feature. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GML+XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
